question: What is the keyboard shortcut for opening a blank new document in MS-Word?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ctrl + N**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ctrl + N** is the keyboard shortcut for opening a blank new document in MS-Word.
 
• Using this shortcut allows users to quickly start a new document without navigating through the menu options.
 
• Keyboard shortcuts can significantly enhance productivity by reducing the time taken to perform common tasks.
 
• Other common keyboard shortcuts in MS-Word include **Ctrl + S** to save a document, **Ctrl + C** to copy selected text, and **Ctrl + V** to paste copied text.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• MS-Word is a widely used word processing software developed by Microsoft.
 
• It is part of the Microsoft Office suite and is available for both Windows and macOS operating systems.
 
• MS-Word offers a variety of features including text formatting, spell check, grammar check, and the ability to insert images, tables, and charts.
 
• Understanding and utilizing keyboard shortcuts can greatly improve efficiency when working with MS-Word.
